facts.fact: In Cycles, film_exposure multiplies the rendered values themselves, so it shows in the float EXR (0.125 at film_exposure 2 wrote 0.25); the view transform's exposure (stops) changes only the display-referred PNG and leaves the EXR at 0.125. They stack: film 2 with +1 EV wrote byte 188, the PNG of linear 0.5
EEVEE ignores scene.cycles.film_exposure (the EXR and PNG were unchanged at film_exposure 2); the view exposure works the same as in Cycles
